# RC60 — Reopen Closed Buffer

Date: 2026-07-28

Workspace: `/path/to/wscrpt`

Git: not a Git repository in this workspace; checkpoint identity is the source tree at this path plus the artifacts below.

## Change

- Added `Esc U` / `core.reopen-closed-buffer` / `Reopen Closed Buffer`.
- Added `:reopen-closed`, `:reopen-closed-buffer`, and `:undo-close`.
- Closing a file-backed buffer records a bounded path-only history entry with cursor, selection anchor, and viewport metadata.
- Reopening restores the most recently closed file-backed buffer if it still exists as a regular file.
- Reopen history is path-only and never stores unsaved text; recovery journals remain the only unsaved-text mechanism.
- Missing or non-file closed paths are refused visibly without creating a file or switching source.
- `Esc K` / `:close-others` also records file-backed closed buffers into the same reopen stack after a successful clean close.
- Updated README and the real-iPad QA matrix to cover key route, command route, metadata restore, and stale-path refusal.
